parallels.note: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

translations.web: The priests could not enter into Yahweh’s house, because Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: The priests were unable to enter the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled it.
translations.kjv: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD'S house.
translations.asv: And the priests could not enter into the house of Jehovah, because the glory of Jehovah filled Jehovah's house.
